text: Election of the Chair for the Property Standards Committee, North York Panel under Municipal Code Chapter 27, Council Procedures, Appendix AII, for the appointed Term of Office ending October 26, 2026, and until a successor is appointed.
The Property Standards Committee, North York Panel: 1. Elected Robert Ruggiero as the Panel Chair for a term of office expiring October 26, 2026, and until a successor is elected.
